values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753728 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753728 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a vault toilet, primitive campsites and a concrete boat ramp; no drinking water listed. Accessibility rated 'Easy'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753728 (Facilities: 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet (Vault)', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Easy Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (2.2 acres, ~3,490 ft) on the Missouri River with designated primitive camping (Region 4). Directions (FWP): Take Wolf Creek Exit 226 off I-15, then 3 miles north on Recreation Road. No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: confirmed $12/$18 FAS camping, vault toilet, primitive campsites, concrete ramp; added the 7-day stay limit.
